description: P1-a fake catalog (docs/commercial-transaction-flow.md 7): make present-p1a. Each customer first confirms a delegation (the host's terms: purpose, task budget, allow_max, approval deadline; the merchants and asset are the profile's), then the Agent runs the main line and requests the brief; 0.50 test USDC is above allow_max 0.10, so it asks. Approval is the fake-only simulated approver (the host plays the customer, not a person's verification); an approval leaves one simulated grant and enables no payment. Fake CLI only, no model, no key, no transaction. Not a policy change and not agent input.
